messages.subject: scroll panels in a shiny app
parts:
My shiny app (ClinicalTrialDesignExperimenter) 
needs a scrollable panel below some fixed items.
I wrestled with this for a long time.
Using <div style="overflow-y: auto; max-height: 400px;" >
worked great in Firefox, but in Chrome and Safari the content of the panel
did not show up.  (The scrolling content would flash then disappear.)

I just stumbled on an answer.
I placed the following between the fixed content above
and the scrolling panel below:
    HTML(' ')
Any "visible" content will do...
for example I now use 
   tagAppendAttributes(em( textOutput("SCENARIO_TREE_label"), class="clickMeToClearSelection"))
you could replace the nbsp with any string for example, 
but interposing br() or hr()  instead
is not sufficient to solve the problem.

The "fixed" stuff above ended with a series of conditional panels.
With a little experimenting it seems that's the cause of the problem.
Thus the immediate predecessor of the panel must be not conditional.

Maybe this note will save somebody vast numbers of google hours.
